text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early on the morning of a major milestone, as serious
training with Seiun Sky begins in preparation for
the challenge of the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Hup~.
Ooh, did that hit a good spot?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No wind, and the waves are calm.
Today is truly the perfect day for fishing."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you cast a line too, Trainer?
You can prop your rod on the cooler box.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "All that's left is to lay back, relax, and wait for a bite. Easy, right?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh? But according to the Sei-chan Memo, today was marked as "Fishing Day☆"?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~, just kidding!
I got it, don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Full-scale training starts today!
It's a super, super important milestone, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Sei-chan makes a powerful proposal.
That's exactly why! We should go fishing!"
choice_data_list: ...And what is the meaning behind that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, catch a big one to bring good luck☆
Let's make these three years celebratory and floundertastic~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You were supposed to call me out on that just now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well! We'll catch something soon... surely, probably? So let's do our training after that~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is moody. She might just be using a morale boost as an excuse to skip training. But still...
choice_data_list: Once we catch something, we're heading back to the academy.
Once we catch something, let's head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~? Do you really believe
I can reel in a big catch?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? The results will be revealed after the commercial break!
Just kidding~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Seiun Sky had just been messing around, but thirty minutes later..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Did it bite deep?♪
Trainer-san, get the landing net ready!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry and grab the net!
We're pulling it up... and heeeave!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap flap flap flap!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Here it is! A flounder, about 40 cm class!
A bonafide big catch~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, seriously.
To think we'd catch something this huge.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! I present this righteye flounder
to you, Trainer. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Honestly, just take it as my thanks for keeping me company so early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides... we're gonna be reeling in
even bigger 'trophy catches' together from now on, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: One in April next year, one in May, and then... one in October. I'd like at least three, I suppose~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The timing and the description of being a "heavyweight"
both fit the Classic Triple Crown, made up of the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then!
Fish is best when it's fresh! So with that said~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A kitchen knife, a cutting board, and a full set of seasonings!
We've even prepared a giant pot big enough to braise whole fish!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now it's up to Trainer to handle the rest☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously.
Would you really put a kitchen knife in the hands of such a delicate Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, I kinda wanna take a break.
Walking all over looking for a good spot—oh."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oops.
I wasn't supposed to say that.
choice_data_list: You really put a lot of work into prepping this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, coming back empty-handed is part of fishing, but since we're here, ya wanna catch what you're aiming for, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look up the intel, read the tide, set up the tactics.
If that's all it takes to win, might as well win, y'know?
choice_data_list: Just like a race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, if races went as smoothly as that,
it'd certainly be a blessing, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, I've chattered on for too long.
Sei-chan's gonna get some shut-eye now."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wake me up when it's ready, okay? Preferably with the wonderful aroma of broth♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well then, looking forward to working with you~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...*sleeping soundly*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Elusive as a drifting cloud,
Seiun Sky. Together with her,
the days of aiming for the "big one" had begun!
